name: byeppt
description: AI-native presentation studio (editor + agent-driven deck generation)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @byeppt/i18n && npm run test -w @byeppt/electron-utils && npm run test -w @byeppt/font-metrics && npm run test -w @byeppt/docx-engine && npm run test -w @byeppt/file-parse && npm run test -w @byeppt/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @byeppt/pptx-render && npm run test -w @byeppt/project-store && npm run test -w @byeppt/app && npm run test -w @byeppt/shell
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/ui && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/app && npm run typecheck -w @byeppt/shell
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n slides,preload,shell -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @byeppt/app" "npm run dev:preload -w @byeppt/app" "cross-env SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 npm run dev -w @byeppt/shell"
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build -w @byeppt/app && npm run dist:win -w @byeppt/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build -w @byeppt/app && npm run dist:mac:arm64 -w @byeppt/shell && npm run dist:mac:x64 -w @byeppt/shell
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run notices && npm run build -w @byeppt/app && npm run dist:mac:arm64 -w @byeppt/shell
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run notices && npm run build -w @byeppt/app && npm run dist:mac:x64 -w @byeppt/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build -w @byeppt/app && npm run dist:linux -w @byeppt/shell
